message: Foreign name transliterations with titles (e.g. 梅杰夫大师, 梅林侯爵) leak into translation as Han-Viet (đại sư Mai Kiệt Phu) instead of Latin (đại sư Medvedev, hầu tước Merlin)

context: NMT ONNX Runtime / Optimum MarianMT KV Cache
message: Merged MarianMT decoder returns dummy past_key_values for encoder cross-attention on step > 0 causing OrtException and repetition penalty truncating Sino-Vietnamese names
stack_trace_snippet: OrtException: Non-zero status code: 1, message: Error in execution: Inconsistent shapes
root_cause: 1) Optimum merged decoder model (decoder_model_merged.onnx) returns dummy (0, 8, 1, 72) for encoder cross-attention key/values when use_cache_branch=True, meaning encoder past_key_values must remain constant from step 0; 2) Hachimi-QT has headDimension=72 (d_model=576, heads=8) while standard Hachimi has headDimension=64 (d_model=512, heads=8), requiring dynamic cache dimensioning; 3) QT vocabulary contains duplicate syllables common in Sino-Vietnamese names and onomatopoeia; noRepeatNgramSize > 0 dropped critical terms.
fix_applied: 1) Preserved encoder KV caches across all decoding steps and only updated decoder self-attention caches in HachimiOnnxTranslator.kt; 2) Parameterized createEmptyCache using descriptor.headDimension (72 for QT, 64 for standard); 3) Enforced noRepeatNgramSize = 0 when QT model is active.

message: Download finished reaching 100% but failed to complete and restart from 0% due to SHA-256 mismatch and retry loop
root_cause: The base ZeroTTS model package in dist/zerotts/legado-tts-zerotts-base.zip was repackaged with mixed-precision INT8 quantization giving SHA-256 57bbbbd098ac4a048d8d3b2264ebf31f785af17c66b2a2649aee830b38685cbd, and uploaded to Hugging Face. However, ExternalAssetCatalog.kt and hf-artifacts-manifest.json contained a stale hash 855d4ff756f8cf0f8fbb0652128f0e89f719aaa5b38d0907072ace05d921573a from an earlier packaging run. When download finished, verifyFile/actualSha256 check failed, deleted the temp part file, and isRetryableAssetFailure returned true for non-HTTP IOExceptions, causing the download to loop from 0%.
fix_applied: 1) Updated ExternalAssetCatalog.kt with exact SHA-256 hashes for ZeroTTS base (57bbbb...) and 8 voice addons. 2) Updated build-hf-asset-manifest.ps1 to compute sizes and SHA-256 dynamically from repo files. 3) Re-generated hf-artifacts-manifest.json and deployed updated functions asset-ticket and asset-download to Supabase project faegbafmkpsocoecrhvz. 4) Modified AssetDeliveryRepository.kt isRetryableAssetFailure to immediately abort without retrying on permanent checksum or size mismatch errors.

message: TTS playback hung indefinitely after a sentence with highlight stuck on screen due to AudioFlinger createTrack watchdog timeout and unhandled ExoPlayer playback error
stack_trace_snippet: androidx.media3.exoplayer.audio.AudioSink$InitializationException: AudioTrack init failed ... Caused by: java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException: Cannot create AudioTrack
root_cause: 1) LocalTtsReadAloudService called player.stop() unconditionally on every paragraph transition in synthesizeCurrentParagraph(), destroying the underlying Android AudioTrack and forcing ExoPlayer to recreate a new AudioTrack via IAudioFlinger::createTrack for each sentence. 2) Under heavy CPU load during background ONNX prefetching, Android audio HAL getLatency() timed out (>14s), causing audioserver to abort via TimeCheck watchdog. 3) LocalTtsReadAloudService lacked onPlayerError implementation in Player.Listener, causing ExoPlayer to remain stuck in STATE_IDLE without firing STATE_ENDED or advancing paragraphs.
fix_applied: 1) Removed unconditional player.stop() between paragraphs in LocalTtsReadAloudService to reuse the existing AudioTrack without recreating it. 2) Added onPlayerError listener to Player.Listener with automatic retry (up to 3 attempts with backoff) and fallback advancement if audio hardware fails. 3) Added a 200ms delay before prefetch inference to eliminate CPU contention during audio track start.

message: ZeroTTS playback hung indefinitely when encountering long paragraphs (>200 chars) due to quadratic O(N^2) autoregressive attention latency (>2.5 min) and Android LMK killing :tts_onnx process
stack_trace_snippet: lowmemorykiller: Kill 'com.drducbook.app.debug:tts_onnx' (13153) to free 2981100kB rss; reason: low watermark is breached and thrashing (464%)
root_cause: 1) ZeroTTS autoregressive loop has O(N^2) attention complexity and continuously accumulates KV cache in memory. When reading long paragraphs (e.g. 247 chars with only commas), a single synthesize() call generated >250 frames, taking >2.5 minutes of 100% CPU and ballooning RSS memory to 2.98 GB, triggering Android kernel lowmemorykiller (LMK) to terminate :tts_onnx. 2) Because the service process was silently killed by SIGKILL, the main reader UI received no error callback and remained permanently frozen on the text highlight.
fix_applied:
1) Implemented hierarchical text chunking (splitIntoChunks) in ZeroTtsOnnxEngine companion object with maxChars=120, breaking long texts at sentence boundaries (.!?;
) then clause punctuation (,:—-""“”«»()), and packing clauses up to maxChars. 2) Chunk synthesis runs sequentially with isolated KV cache lifetimes and concatenates audio parts with 80ms silence. 3) Added cancellation checking (checkCancelled?.invoke()) both between chunks and every 10 autoregressive loop frames. 4) Added ZeroTtsChunkerTest suite covering all boundary cases. Validated live continuous reading on Android.

message: ZeroTTS hung indefinitely (46 min CPU) and occupied 2.3 GB RAM on physical ARM big.LITTLE phone due to disabled CPU arena allocator, over-threading across Cortex-A510 little cores, and prefetch race condition re-synthesizing paragraphs twice
root_cause: 1) Disabling CPU arena allocator and memory pattern optimization forced ONNX Runtime to malloc/free tens of thousands of tensors per chunk, fragmenting Android scudo heap to 2.3 GB RSS and thrashing Linux swap. 2) optimalThreadCount=6 forced intra-op execution onto Cortex-A510 little cores, making Cortex-A710 big cores block at futex barriers on every single-token local_frame_decode step. 3) clearPrefetch() cancelled in-flight prefetch jobs upon paragraph transition without saving WAV, forcing synthesizeCurrentParagraph() to re-synthesize the same paragraph from scratch, doubling user wait time to ~9 minutes.
fix_applied: 1) Re-enabled setCPUArenaAllocator(true) and setMemoryPatternOptimization(true) in ZeroTtsOnnxEngine. 2) Tuned threading: clamped optimalThreadCount to 4 big cores max, and configured dedicated arOptions with 2 threads for local_frame_decode single-token loop. 3) Reused reusable direct buffer ctrlRandomDirect eliminating per-frame floatArray allocations. 4) Tracked currentlyPrefetchingIndex in LocalTtsReadAloudService and joined active prefetch instead of cancelling and re-synthesizing. 5) Reduced PREFETCH_LOOKAHEAD_COUNT to 2 and added 100ms delay between prefetch chunks.

message: ul.q cannot be cast to ul.r (com.google.gson.JsonNull cannot be cast to com.google.gson.JsonObject) during SSE streaming with DeepSeek and OpenAI-compatible providers
stack_trace_snippet: java.lang.ClassCastException: ul.q cannot be cast to ul.r at OpenAiChatHandler$streamInternal$response$1$1.invoke (OpenAiChatHandler.kt:188)
root_cause: 1) OpenAiChatHandler, GeminiHandler, OpenAiResponsesHandler, AntigravityHandler, and ChatGptWebHandler called getAsJsonObject() and getAsJsonArray() directly on JSON fields (such as 'usage', 'delta', 'annotations', 'citationMetadata') that can be null or JsonNull in intermediate stream chunks (e.g. when include_usage=true or on finish). In Gson, getAsJsonObject casts members.get() directly, throwing ClassCastException when the value is JsonNull, which manifested as 'ul.q cannot be cast to ul.r' in R8 minified release builds. 2) OpenCode Free tier Zen endpoint (opencode.ai/zen/v1) was restricted by upstream server in late Sep 2026 with 403 Forbidden 'OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode', causing auto-installed free routes to fail permanently without clear guidance.
fix_applied: 1) Added null-safe optJsonObject() and optJsonArray() in AiSseUtils.kt and hardened asJsonObjectOrNull/asJsonArrayOrNull to check !isJsonNull. 2) Replaced all unsafe getAsJsonObject/getAsJsonArray calls across all protocol handlers. 3) Added ClassCastException to AiFailureKind.PROTOCOL classification in AiProviderFailureClassifier. 4) Added friendly guidance for OpenCode free tier 403 restriction. 5) Retired catalog_opencode_free from autoInstallIds and combo templates. 6) Added explicit ProGuard keep rules for AiStreamEvent subclasses and Gson JSON types.

message: Author note test failure: 'tự vui trong thế giới riêng' incorrectly inverted into 'trong thế giới tự vui riêng'
root_cause: compilePostRule in QuickTranslationRepository unconditionally compiles regexes with RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE. Consequently, a character class [A-Z...] meant for capitalized proper names matched lowercase words as well, causing 'tự vui trong thế giới riêng' to match '\b([A-Z...]+) trong thế giới\b' and produce 'trong thế giới tự vui riêng'.
fix_applied: Constrained named world and temple post-rule patterns in qt_clean_rules_v8.tsv to explicit list of universe/book names (Dương Thần, Chư Thần, etc.) and temple names (Đại Thiền, Thiếu Lâm, etc.), plus quoted 《...》 patterns, preventing unwanted inversions on generic lowercase Vietnamese phrases.

message: No event / nothing happens when clicking 'Nhập URL/file JSON registry VBook' or 'Tình trạng nguồn' in BookSourceActivity menu
root_cause: BookSourceActivity attempted to launch MainActivity with startActivity<MainActivity> { putExtra(MainIntent.EXTRA_START_ROUTE, ...) }. Because MainActivity has standard launchMode and is in the same task affinity, calling startActivity with FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK from a foreground task already hosting that affinity causes Android to merely bring the task to front without starting the target activity or firing onNewIntent. Additionally, Launcher0 was the actual root launcher component rather than MainActivity.
fix_applied: Created standalone BaseComposeActivity containers (VbookImportActivity, SourceHealthActivity) wrapping VbookImportRouteScreen and SourceHealthRouteScreen, registered them in AndroidManifest.xml, and updated BookSourceActivity menu handlers to launch them directly with onResume source list auto-refresh.

message: Clicking 'Tạo ảnh' crashes or does nothing due to credential.id instead of secretRef, quality 'medium' rejected by DALL-E, and chat models assigned to image preset
root_cause: 1) OpenAiImageRepository used credential.id instead of credential.secretRef to look up API key in secretStore, returning empty key and throwing IllegalArgumentException; 2) quality was set to 'medium' which OpenAI DALL-E rejects with HTTP 400; 3) AiProfileRepository saveDefaultPresets assigned user's chat model to GENERATE_STORY_IMAGE preset; 4) StoryIllustrationUseCase resolveDefaultImagePreset fell back to OpenAI text model (gpt-4o) calling /images/generations; 5) StoryMemoryEditorDialog lacked progress indicator when saving=true.
fix_applied: 1) Fixed secretStore.get(credential.secretRef) in OpenAiImageRepository; 2) Changed quality to 'standard' in AiModels.kt and mapped in OpenAiImageRepository; 3) Only upsert GENERATE_STORY_IMAGE if model is an image generation model; 4) Fixed resolveDefaultImagePreset to strictly require image capabilities/names; 5) Added LinearProgressIndicator and CircularProgressIndicator in StoryMemoryEditorDialog.

message: Retranslate chapter disabled and refresh translation does not change translation content
root_cause: 1) TranslateChapterUseCase intercepted all forceRetranslate=true calls when provider was AI, returning old cached translation under AI_CACHE_PRESERVED without calling LLM or writing cache, disabling 'Dịch lại chương' and leaving 'Làm mới bản dịch' unchanged; 2) ReadBookViewModel refreshCurrentChapter called BookHelp.delContent (raw) without calling TranslationManager.deleteTranslationCache (translations); 3) StoryMemory retrofitChapterTranslations did not notify Reader or clear ReadBook.curTextChapter.
fix_applied: 1) Separated retrofitWithExistingDraft from forceRetranslate in TranslateChapterUseCase; forceRetranslate now always performs full retranslation; retrofitWithExistingDraft updates canonical memory terms and writes back to disk cache; 2) Called TranslationManager.deleteTranslationCache in refreshCurrentChapter(); 3) In BookStoryMemoryViewModel.executeRetrofit, cleared ReadBook.clearTextChapter() and posted EventBus.REFRESH_BOOK_CONTENT.

message: Severe GC thrashing and lag during translation rendering due to untriggered regex storm, unbounded candidate exploration, and TOC emission thrashing
root_cause: 1) 64/202 post-rules lacked literal triggers, evaluating regexes unconditionally; 2) SelectionResolver tested up to 400 candidate substrings per tap; 3) TocViewModel emitted every batch of 50 chapters causing continuous remapping and NativeAlloc GC of 750k objects; 4) NetworkUtils threw MalformedURLException on data URIs; 5) Ephemeral UI cache used multi-step atomic writes
fix_applied: 1) Expanded literal trigger detection to 97.5% of post-rules with fast paths; 2) Bounded selection candidates to 40; 3) Throttled TocViewModel emissions; 4) Added data URL fast path in NetworkUtils; 5) Replaced atomic writes with direct writeText for UI cache

message: Supabase API key sync fails with HTTP 400 NoSuchKey or 404 when uploading new object via PUT
root_cause: Supabase Storage API requires HTTP POST with x-upsert: true when creating a new object at /storage/v1/object/{bucket}/{path}; using HTTP PUT directly on a non-existent object path returns HTTP 400 NoSuchKey
fix_applied: Added postFile method with x-upsert: true header support in SupabaseAuthenticatedRestClient and switched ApiKeySyncRepository and SupabaseAccountCloudBackupRepository to use postFile(..., upsert = true)

message: Chatbot repeated tool call without progress: search_online_books and fallback cascade to gpt-oss with HTTP 400 Expected input to contain field: 'json_schema'
stack_trace_snippet: Stream interrupted: Chatbot repeated tool call without progress: search_online_books
root_cause: 1) In AiRouterRepository.kt, hasContent was only set to true on non-blank AiStreamEvent.Content; when models emitted AiStreamEvent.ToolCallDelta (typical for function-calling LLMs returning empty content body), hasContent remained false, triggering IllegalStateException('Empty AI response') and recording failure on the target; 2) Since the stream was non-buffered, candidate 0 emitted its ToolCallDelta before being marked failed, then failover repeated across all candidates (13 total), emitting 13 duplicate tool calls downstream until AiChatViewModel activeToolLoopGuard aborted; 3) All 12 Gemini models were placed on cooldown, falling back to gpt-oss-120b-medium which rejected Gemini function calling format with HTTP 400.
fix_applied: 1) In AiRouterRepository.kt, updated generateStream to set hasContent = true on AiStreamEvent.ToolCallDelta and non-blank Content/Reasoning, and recorded firstEventAt on ToolCallDelta/Reasoning/Content; 2) In AntigravityHandler.kt, stripped tools and toolConfig for gpt-oss models; 3) Verified live on LDPlayer emulator with successful round-1 function execution, book search card rendering, and clean interactive chat response.

message: NPE on AgentDashboardViewModel: Parameter specified as non-null is null: method io.legado.app.ui.ai.agent.AgentDashboardViewModelKt.buildAgentDashboardUiState, parameter toolPermissions
stack_trace_snippet:
java.lang.NullPointerException: Parameter specified as non-null is null: method io.legado.app.ui.ai.agent.AgentDashboardViewModelKt.buildAgentDashboardUiState, parameter toolPermissions
	at io.legado.app.ui.ai.agent.AgentDashboardViewModelKt.buildAgentDashboardUiState(Unknown Source:61)
	at io.legado.app.ui.ai.agent.AgentDashboardViewModel.createUiState(AgentDashboardViewModel.kt:333)
root_cause: In AgentDashboardViewModel, _uiState was initialized at line 47 calling createUiState() with default argument toolPermissions = this.toolPermissions, but the toolPermissions backing property was declared at line 58. In Kotlin class initialization, properties are initialized top-to-bottom, so this.toolPermissions was still null when createUiState() evaluated, triggering an intrinsic null check failure on buildAgentDashboardUiState.
fix_applied: Reordered property declarations in AgentDashboardViewModel so that all backing state properties (recentRuns, recentMemories, pendingProposalCount, recentProposals, recentAudits, skills, toolPermissions) are initialized before _uiState.

message: Raw mapping error when adding QT dictionary entry: whole paragraph offered and raw field left blank
root_cause: 1) alignedParagraphMapping collapses entire chapter to 1 low-confidence segment when source and display line counts differ (80 vs 79); 2) sourceSearchWindow abandons paragraph mapping on line count mismatch and falls back to linear interpolation with 192-char radius; 3) MAX_GLOBAL_ALIGNMENT_SOURCE_CHARS (2400) blocks fallback on chapters > 2400 chars (standard is 3500-8000 chars); 4) selectionStart drifts due to paragraphIndent not accounted for; 5) whole paragraph offered as dictionary term alternative
fix_applied: 1) Upgraded alignedParagraphMapping with non-blank line alignment (0.75f) and proportional mapping (0.60f) when line counts differ; 2) Calibrated trimmedSelection start with findNearestOccurrence in displayText; 3) Enhanced sourceSearchWindow to use mappedSelection coordinates and proportional line segments; 4) Expanded SEARCH_RADIUS to 512, SEARCH_RADIUS_FALLBACK to 1024, and MAX_GLOBAL_ALIGNMENT_SOURCE_CHARS to 20,000; 5) Filtered alternatives to exclude raw text > 16 chars or containing newlines; 6) Expanded findTranslatedRange maxChars to 10 and starts to 80; 7) Added comprehensive unit tests in QuickDictionarySelectionResolverTest.

message: Thieu de xuat han viet va tran khong gian dialog do luoi FlowRow filter chips
root_cause: 1) TranslationConstants did not define PROVIDER_HAN_VIET, so Han-Viet could not be queried or suggested; 2) BookStoryMemoryViewModel lacked Han-Viet pre-computation on dialog open; 3) StoryMemoryEditorDialog used an 8-chip FlowRow grid occupying excessive vertical space.
fix_applied: 1) Added PROVIDER_HAN_VIET to TranslationConstants providerValues and displayNames; 2) Handled PROVIDER_HAN_VIET in TranslateChapterUseCase and injected QuickTranslationGateway into BookStoryMemoryViewModel for instant pre-population; 3) Replaced FlowRow filter chips in BookStoryMemoryScreen with compact StoryMemoryDropdownField and OutlinedButton suggestion rows; 4) Verified compilation, tests, APK assembly, and installed onto emulator-5554.
